name: Vault — Add To My Shelf From CSV

parameters.responseBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ ok: true, started: true, matched: $json.ids.length, lookingUp: $json.search.length, alreadyHad: $json.alreadyHad }) }}

options.queryReplacement: ={{ [$('Validate').first().json.email, $('Start').first().json.r.search.length ? 'Looking up ' + $('Start').first().json.r.search.length + ' games on BGG' : 'Getting game details and box art'] }}

parameters.query: SELECT bgc.set_import($1, jsonb_build_object('step', 'Getting game details and box art')) AS s

SELECT x -> 'records' AS records, x ->> 'id' AS id, x ->> 'createdTime' AS "createdTime", x -> 'fields' AS fields, (x ->> 'deleted')::boolean AS deleted FROM (SELECT at.request($1, $2, $3, $4::jsonb, $5) AS x) q
